title: Design- Row height in Tech View, Card size in Board View (design's version)
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the density button left of the display switcher.
  2. Read the options.
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  5. Read the controls in the toolbar.
  6. Click the card size button.
  7. Read the options.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a menu opens headed "Row height".
  • Step 2: the options are "Small", "Medium" and "Large".
  • Step 3: the menu closes.
  • Step 4: Board View shows.
  • Step 5: there is a "Card size" button and no "Fields to display" button.
  • Step 6: a menu opens.
  • Step 7: the options are "Compact" and "Detailed".

This case checks the DESIGN's version, which differs from the PRD: Density control names: the design shows Tech View "Row height: Small / Medium / Large"; Board View "Card size: Compact / Detailed" (seen when driven, FLOWS W4); the PRD says "Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View and Board View.". Fields to display on Board View: the design shows no Fields to display picker on Board View (only Card size) (seen when driven, FLOWS W4); the PRD says "Board View offers a separate Fields to display picker …". It is held until Chris Ward rules on rows D11, D12 of the WO Board design-differences question sheet for Chris Ward (19 Oct 2026). Do not run it while it is held. If he rules for the design, it is released; if he rules for the PRD, it is removed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

What the PRD says instead:

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 66 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043

  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View and Board View.”
  • S5-R2: “Board View offers a separate Fields to display picker in the same toolbar position and with the same interaction as the column chooser.”
